# wso2is_passive_sts_configuration (Resource)

Manages the WS-Federation (passive STS) endpoint. The resource only changes the settings that you set. Other settings keep their current values. When you destroy this resource, the provider restores the server defaults. Each tenant (or organization) has one set of these settings. To import them, use the ID `passive_sts_configuration`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wso2is_passive_sts_configuration" "this" {
  enable_request_signing = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enable_request_signing` (Boolean) Sign authentication requests.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `passive_sts_configuration`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import wso2is_passive_sts_configuration.this passive_sts_configuration
```
